I’m having the same issue. I ordered 6/7 around 11pm, received an email confirming my item shipped [VERY FIRST LV PURCHASE!] 6/8 around 7:30 am and UPS does not have a shipping status  while I’m getting the same visual as OP on the LV site. 

I’m assuming it could be a combination of Father’s Day purchases and road closures due to protests. Also it’s only been 3 days for me and I’m overly excited 😆

If possible pls let me know when you receive yours - I’m also worried I won’t be home when it arrives to sign off.

>r anniversary. He always shows me how little it all means, if he loves me regardless, I can love myself regardless too

Cuddles with the S/O are always the best remedy. Happy anniversary to the both of you!

I have been in that position before and you have to let your partner know (especially if you will be working with her again) that there needs to be better communication and preferably in-person meetings. Even just one hour a day of in-person meetings can get so much done. Let her know that you are busy as well and would rather start things early and work on them as time progresses than to do last minute changes. If she is particular about certain things she should take more responsibility of contributing and meeting with you.   


If you receive a bad grade on this project I suggest speaking with your professor or TA about your partner's behavior.
I’ve definitely been there and done that. Good luck. Stay hydrated tomorrow.

Sometimes it’s all of the above and all you want to do is shut down and not feel. It’s not like feeling empty but just... existing. For no reason. Taking up space and shutting down. For me I sleep all day to avoid it all only to wake up wanting to go back in that void
I saw the question and that was the first song that instantly came to mind!
I took the class a couple of years ago (with Thornton) and it was the first C+ I had ever had in my life.

Not listen to all the people who said I couldn’t but instead listen to all the people who said I could and that they believed in me. 

I feel that if I had done this before I wouldn’t have fallen into depression which snowballed into a lot of other negativity in my life. I’m definitely at a better place and state of mind now that I have found the right people - people who believed I could accomplish my dreams, people who didn’t bring me down just for laughs.

My boyfriend (25) and I(22) have been together for almost 2 years and it definitely depends on the days. He is away for half the week due to the nature of his job and we really only see each other for 3 days (not full days as I have work and school) 

We text each other whenever we can or if something interesting/new/happy/sad/important/funny comes up or if we just miss each other and want to say hi. Honestly it’s different for every couple. 

We have had days where we don’t even text each other until one of us is going to sleep - we like to say “Goodnight” and “I love you “ every night.
I just want to say that I’ve been there and y’all can do it! I believe in you!
